title: The asteroid didn't kill the dinosaurs with fire
text:
The asteroid didn't kill the dinosaurs with fire. It killed them with dust.

When the Chicxulub asteroid hit what's now Mexico, it blasted fine silicate dust so high into the atmosphere that it blocked the sun for nearly two years. Photosynthesis shut down almost completely, food chains collapsed from the bottom up, and global temperatures dropped by more than 15 degrees Celsius.

Three quarters of all species on Earth died in the dark, not the blast.
